met_analysis:
The well marked low pressure area over southwest Arabian Sea moved west-northwestwards during past 12 hours and lies over the same region at 0530 hrs IST of today, the 20th October, 2026. It is very likely to continue to move west-northwestwards maintaining its intensity of well marked low pressure area during next 12 hours. Thereafter, it is likely to continue to move further west-northwestwards as a low pressure area till 21st and then west-southwestwards towards Somalia coast on 22nd October.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Southwest Bay of Bengal off north Tamilnadu coasts lies over Southwest Bay of Bengal off South Tamil Nadu coasts and extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The trough runs from the above cyclonic circulation Southwest Bay of Bengal off South Tamil Nadu coasts to Northwest Bay of Bengalbetween 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Interior Karnataka & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from Southwest Rajasthan to Northeast Arabian sea at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Rajasthan & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood persists and now seen at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Gulf of Thailand & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southeast Bangladesh and adjoining Tripura at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over Himachal Pradesh & adjoining Punjab at 3.1 km above mean sea level has become less marked and the trough aloft in middle tropospheric levels with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 72°E to the North of Lat. 32°N moved away east northeastwards.
